reconciliation.title: Reconciliation and balance checks
reconciliation.subtitle: Daily UTC reconciliation reports, on-chain anomaly statistics, and read-only customer balance ledger verification.
reconciliation.dailyNote: The previous UTC day snapshot is generated after 00:05. Revenue uses paid_at, order counts use created_at, successful delivery uses delivered_at, and failed delivery uses failure-event time. Supplier balance uses the latest snapshot within that UTC day; historical reports are snapshots taken at generation time.
reconciliation.noReports: No daily reports for this month yet. The previous day's report is generated after 00:05 UTC.
reconciliation.readOnlyNote: Read-only check. Customer balances and ledger entries are never modified. Credits are positive and debits negative; store refunds are wallet credits and therefore count as positive ledger entries.
reconciliation.noAnomalies: No balance differences found in this check
